purpose: Teach: 割高/協業/行程/必勝/品切れ/伝言/月給/当座

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、輸入機材の割高な分は研究費から拠出する
lines.en: Ren — I'll have the research fund cover the markup on the imported equipment.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Clean attack on the name. Matter-of-fact tone, no hesitation. The voice of someone who has already decided and is simply informing. Steady eye contact through the full statement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。他大学との協業研究を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with collaborative research across universities.
lines.style: Careful, earnest response. Slight hesitation before the main clause—showing he's thinking through his words. Respectful but not submissive. A young researcher reporting honestly on progress, wanting to prove he's on top of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の執筆行程を逆算しろ
lines.en: Ren — work backwards from your paper deadline.
lines.style: Crisp, practical direction. No softening. The name lands as a straightforward call to attention. Voice is efficient, clean—a mentor who trusts you to understand why this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表で必勝のプレゼンを用意します
lines.en: Yes. I'm preparing a solid presentation for the conference.
lines.style: Quick, determined response. A small click of commitment on 「必勝」—winning matters to him. Professional tone, but underneath it's personal drive. He's promising himself as much as his adviser.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、図書館の参考書が品切れだ
lines.en: Ren — the library's reference materials are out of stock.
lines.style: Brief, factual statement. No apology in the tone—just informing. The name serves as a checkpoint. Composed delivery, as if presenting a problem that requires a solution.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教授への伝言を学生間で共有しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already shared the message with my fellow students.
lines.style: Quick, responsive. Pride of initiative barely hidden beneath the politeness. He's already moved—this wasn't an order that needed executing, it's a problem he solved. Small satisfied undertone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、博士課程の月給支援制度を確認しろ
lines.en: Ren — check into the doctoral stipend system.
lines.style: Steady direction, slightly more personal in tone than the others. Not quite paternal, but there's a concern underneath—he's thinking about Ren's survival, not just his research. Clear, practical, delivered with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当座の生活費は奨学金で賄います
lines.en: Yes. I'm covering my living expenses with my scholarship for now.
lines.style: Respectful close. Slight hesitation—he doesn't want to sound like he's struggling or asking for sympathy. Matter-of-fact on the surface, but carrying a quiet self-sufficiency underneath. Small fade at the end, letting the statement rest.
